claim: Open Targets Platform is an external data-integration tool for systematic therapeutic target identification and prioritization, including target-disease association evidence and downloadable platform data.
future_grounding_route: Specific Open Targets MS target-disease associations can be queued as external-verifiable hypotheses and grounded against project-held genetics, eQTL, perturbation, and treatment-response data.
project_use: Competitor/source cataloging and future therapeutic-hypothesis triage.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Broad target-disease association and drug-target prioritization resource across many evidence types.
why_unverifiable: The project cannot rerun Open Targets' full external data integration, evidence scoring, and release pipeline from this repository.
